# Msg

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

A read-only message header with lazy access to its message body.

[Behavior, constraints and examples](../../../new_ppl.md#messages-400).

```{warning}
Message reads do not apply the interactive reader's access/privacy filtering. The PPE must enforce visibility; `Valid` alone is not an access check. See [message visibility](../../../new_ppl.md#who-may-see-a-message-is-the-programs-decision).
```

## Date

`Msg.Date: DATE`

Read-only instance property.

Native DATE or TIME component of the message's UTC creation timestamp. An invalid message returns an empty value, not midnight or a numeric zero.

## From

`Msg.From: STRING`

Read-only instance property.

Read-only sender, recipient, subject, or status text from the message header.

## Header

`Msg.Header: MSGHEADER`

Read-only instance property.

Returns an independent mutable MSGHEADER copy of this message's header. Changes remain local until explicitly passed to a Session message operation.

## MarkRead

```PPL
Msg.MarkRead() BOOLEAN
```

Instance function.

Marks mail addressed to the current user's name or alias as read, sets the received timestamp and generates any requested return receipt. Returns TRUE for eligible mail, including already-read mail; FALSE otherwise. Failures update Error.Last(). Does not advance last-read pointers or change this snapshot.

## Text

```PPL
Msg.Text() STRING
```

Instance function.

Loads and returns the message body on demand. I/O failures return an empty string and update `Error.Last()`.

## Time

`Msg.Time: TIME`

Read-only instance property.

Native DATE or TIME component of the message's UTC creation timestamp. An invalid message returns an empty value, not midnight or a numeric zero.

## Valid

`Msg.Valid: BOOLEAN`

Read-only instance property.

Whether this value names an existing message. Missing or out-of-range reads return an invalid `MSG` instead of failing the member chain.

## WrittenAt

`Msg.WrittenAt: TIMESTAMP`

Read-only instance property.

Native UTC timestamp, retaining the precision of the backing data. Writable user expiry fields reject empty values. Invalid objects return empty.
